notes: GAME STRUCTURE: Crime empire RPG. v0.22.0. City=Ambush Alley. 7 win goals from Whiteboard: (1) 10k+ money (2) Own warehouse (Harbor-Warehouse district) (3) Own house (browse PC) (4) Meet 4 faction types: mafia/cartels/gangs/bikers via districts (5) Big Shot reputation (6) 3x Block 19 handguns (7) 300+ gang strength via recruiting thugs/thieves from bars/nightclubs — completing all unlocks gang creation.

MAP (image-map with <area data-passage>): Downtown Road, Harbor Road, Suburbs Road, Outskirts Road (Road Blocked initially), City Center Road. 6 districts visible but Outskirts is initially blocked. Factions: Harbor=Cartel, Suburbs=Mafia, St.Gangs=gangs.

CORE STATS (var count: 1123!): money=200 start, dirty_money (2 currencies), reputation, energy=6 (AP), combat=5, p_hp=30, combat_stamina=100. HEAT SYSTEM: global heat + per-faction (gangs/mafia/bikers/cartel). High heat blocks entrances + activities (heat_lab_block, heat_warehouse_block, heat_thieves_block). GANG MGMT (band_*): band_morale=50 start, band_type=Street Gang, band_strength, band_war_progress, auto-dealers for passive income. BANK HEIST (bh_*): hostages, stress, tactical choices (force/appeal/intel/police_con). TERRITORY: spot_attack_timer per district (captured territories defend against attacks). NSFW layered on: arousal, arousal_stage, whore_trait_progress, aphrodisiac systems, nightclub counter. FACTION REPS: pawnshop_rep, hackers_rep, downtown_rep. GUN UPGRADE CHAIN: scrap_shack_gunsmith -> gun_workbench_upgrade -> gunparts_upgrade.

DISTRICTS: (1) CITY CENTER (neutral/police)—Bank, Mall, Park[closed:crime scene gate], Crown Casino, 'Swaying Bazongas' nightclub-for-sale via landlord. (2) DOWNTOWN (Street Gangs): Marketplace, 'The Underworld Lounge' bar, 'Instant Worth Pawn', 'Wild Rabbit' sexshop, 'The Getaway Groove' nightclub, gang stroll, burglary (lockpick). Gang hub hidden—ask around. (3) HARBOR (Cartel): Warehouse district [goal #2], dark alleys, brothel, cartel stroll, beach. Cartel hidden. (4) SUBURBS (Mafia): 'Wheel&Deal' auto workshop, 'Muscle&Mayhem' gym, 'The Eclipse' striptease, mafia stroll, burglary. Mafia HQ hidden. (5) OUTSKIRTS (Bikers): 'The Fringe' club, Junkyard, biker checkpoint, abandoned workshop [$70k → chemistry lab], racetrack (races 8PM), farmers market. Common: car theft at night. Day/night cycle gates activities.

NPC SYSTEM: Socialize at bar (Downtown Bar) rolls a procgen NPC with Name+Role+Wealth status (e.g. Vaughn Manning, Farmer, Low-End). Hidden stats (abilities + engagement status) revealed only with 'Observant' trait. Add to contacts Y/N. Bar also sells Moonshine to barmen (>=5 pcs). Contacts stored in Home>Your Contacts. PC: Web Market (Realtor: $5k flat upgrade, $100k yacht gated on harbor ownership), Messages, news, stocks, power off.

BURGLARY MINIGAME (Complex Burglary passage): Click furniture containers (racks/cupboards/buffet/closet/drawers) one by one to loot. Each click yields Junk or valuables (Silver Ring seen). Some loot triggers 'made some noise'. After enough noise → 'Someone is coming, run!' and choices collapse to 'Run away[1]' only. Consumes lockpick. Alert escalation is the tension mechanic — push-your-luck looting. Location: Downtown residential complex + Suburbs burglary.

SIDEBAR (from PC screenshot): Portrait+name('Nobody.' when unnamed), money/dirty_money display, clock (Tue Jun 1 08:20 = day-of-week + date + hour), quick actions WAIT/INVENTORY/STATS/LOG (image buttons, not text-matchable). Day-of-week drives schedules (e.g. weeklyAllowanceCheck style gates seen in other games).
